title: hordeum × intermedium
intro: Hordeum × intermedium, commonly known as Spelt or Dinkel wheat, is a hybrid wheat species that is a cross between Triticum aestivum (common wheat) and Triticum spelta (spelt). This ancient grain is valued for its potential health benefits, including its high fiber and protein content, which can help lower cholesterol levels and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hordeum × intermedium are attributed to its ability to soothe inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a potential treatment for skin conditions such as eczema. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and avenanthramides, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
